description: A strict-config + ui-health lint standard. Static checks verify `tsconfig` has `strict:true` and that eslint rules `rules-of-hooks`, `no-cycle`, `no-any`, and `no-non-null-assert` are set at error level. Auto-fix can flip these config flags behind a preview.

requirements.description: Static checks must verify `tsconfig` sets `strict:true` and that the eslint rules `rules-of-hooks`, `no-cycle`, `no-any`, and `no-non-null-assert` are configured at error level. A non-strict tsconfig or any of these rules missing/below error must produce a Finding.
requirements.title: Static strict-config + lint-rule checks

validation.notes: A tsconfig without strict:true produces a Finding
Any of rules-of-hooks, no-cycle, no-any, no-non-null-assert not set at error level produces a Finding
A fully strict, fully-configured project produces no strict-config Findings
Run ui-health against a scenario with strict disabled and confirm the strict-config Finding is emitted
The strict-config + ui-health standard enforces type-safety and hook-stability lint rules across UI scenarios

requirements.description: An auto-fixer must be able to flip the strict-config and lint-rule flags to their required values, but only behind a preview (PreviewFix shows the change before ApplyFix writes it). The fixer must be idempotent.
requirements.title: Config-flip fixer behind preview

validation.notes: The config-flip fixer sets strict:true and elevates the four lint rules to error
The fixer is only applied after a preview and is idempotent on re-run
PreviewFix surfaces the proposed config flip without writing any file
Run the config-flip fixer with --apply and confirm the strict-config Findings clear on re-validate
Config flips are auto-remediable but gated behind a preview to keep risky transforms transparent

title: strict-config + ui-health lint standard
